title: High-z̄ MAN backgrounds: EPMA of Trace-element Doped Uranium Metals
content: Mean-atomic-number (MAN) background modeling has been one of the most significant advances in electron probe microanalysis (EPMA), capable of reducing analytical time by >50% and removing off-peak interferences [1]. However, accurately interpreting backgrounds under characteristic peaks requires a robust suite of blank standards—a challenge when analyzing elements at the far ends of the periodic table, such as uranium or beryllium. In this work, we explore both traditional, and multipoint backgrounds and compare it to MAN backgrounds, and explore ways to refine and improve the method for these extreme end members.
